description: This source file defines a singleton object BookRepository that provides mock data and methods for accessing and searching a collection of Book objects within an Android application's data layer.

classes.name: BookRepository
classes.description: A singleton object providing access to a list of books with methods to retrieve all books, search books by query, and get a book by ID.

methods.name: getBooks
methods.description: Returns the full list of books.

methods.name: searchBooks
methods.description: Filters and returns books matching the search query in title or author.

methods.name: getBookById
methods.description: Finds and returns a book by its ID.
